subject: Governance orchestration and regression playbook - MID-1142
messages:
From: Angela Torres <a.torres@midvalehealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Governance and regression protocol clarifications - RFP MID-1142

Connor / Evelyn,

Thanks for the RFP materials — attached is the governance appendix we referenced (Midvale_RFP_Governance_Appendix.pdf). A few points the procurement and security teams asked us to clarify before we move to the vendor evaluation call: 

1) Can you confirm how Redwood maps to NIST AI RMF outcomes for 'Measure' and 'Respond' specifically for model drift and performance degradations?
2) For EU AI Act high-risk classification: do you offer deployment controls that can restrict model variants by region and enable mandatory human oversight workflows?
3) We have a standard ask for a regression cadence and sample sizes used for production rollouts — do you have a templated protocol?
4) Evidence: which artifacts can you provide as part of an assurance package (SOC2, model card, eval harness results, data retention policy)?

We'd appreciate short bullets or a one-page mapping ahead of our scheduled call on Wed. Also attaching a short spreadsheet with our evaluation questions — can you review and indicate where Redwood has a direct artifact?

Thanks,
Angela
Angela Torres
Sr. Procurement Manager, Midvale Health
Angela.Torres@midvalehealth.com
Attachment: Midvale_RFP_Governance_Appendix.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Angela Torres <a.torres@midvalehealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Governance and regression protocol clarifications - RFP MID-1142

Angela — thanks for the clear list and the appendix. High-level answers below; I'll bring Aditya (applied ML) into the thread for protocol specifics and artifacts. I also attached a one-page mapping (redwood-governance-summary.pdf) that aligns NIST outcomes and EU AI Act controls with the artifacts we can provide. Short answers: 

- NIST 'Measure' & 'Respond': we provide continuous monitoring (per-route/per-model metrics), automated regression alerts tied to prompt test suites, and a defined incident response flow that includes rollback and canary policies. For drift detection we expose time-windowed token-level distributions and a signal set that triggers an evaluation job.

- EU AI Act controls: yes — our routing layer can enforce model variant restrictions by region and tenant; we support human-in-the-loop gating for sensitive output types and provide audit trails for oversight decisions.

- Regression cadence & sample sizes: we recommend weekly automated regression runs for high-throughput routes and pre-rollout sampling for canary cohorts (typical sample: 500–2,000 prompts depending on variability). We'll attach a sample regression protocol spreadsheet (regression-protocol-v2.xlsx).

- Evidence artifacts: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), model cards, eval harness results (raw and aggregated), deployment configs, and data retention policies. Some artifacts require executed NDAs — happy to route DocuSign for that.

Next steps: 1) Evelyn and Aditya to confirm the regression template and produce artifact checklist; 2) I can join your Wed call with a 15-minute demo of monitoring dashboards.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-governance-summary.pdf; regression-protocol-v2.xlsx
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Governance and regression protocol clarifications - RFP MID-1142

Eve / Aditya — forwarding Angela's note and my high-level reply. Action items below; please keep answers short so I can send them to Midvale before Wed's call.

Quoted for context:
On Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700 Angela Torres <a.torres@midvalehealth.com> wrote:
> Connor / Evelyn,
> 
> Thanks for the RFP materials — attached is the governance appendix we referenced...

My ask (short):
- Evelyn: produce a 1-page artifact checklist that maps to the NIST outcomes and lists which artifacts we can deliver immediately vs. on NDA. Include SOC 2, model cards, audit logs, KMS integration evidence.
- Aditya: confirm regression cadence recommendations and the default sample sizes we use for production rollouts. Also note which eval metrics are included in our automated run (e.g., BLEU/ROUGE rarely; we use task-specific P0/P1 metrics, perplexity for generative drift, and hallucination-rate proxies).
- Both: estimate time to produce the raw eval harness outputs (if we run the MID-1142 suite) — target: 3 business days after NDA.

Quick bullets to send back to Angela will be best; no long docs at this stage.

Thanks — Connor

From: Angela Torres <a.torres@midvalehealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Governance and regression protocol clarifications - RFP MID-1142

Connor / Evelyn,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attached summary. Procurement has a short list of follow-ups but the security team is satisfied with the mapping so far. Two asks before our vendor evaluation call: 

1) Can you run the simple MID-1142 eval sheet against one of your stable model variants and share the raw harness output (we attached a trimmed list of evaluation prompts in the spreadsheet). We listed desired columns in the sheet.
2) Please confirm which artifacts require an NDA and whether SOC2 redacted copies can be provided in advance.

If you can send the raw harness output and the artifact checklist by EOD Monday, we'll include Redwood in the shortlist for the week-of demos. We attached our evaluation questions file for clarity (midvale-eval-questions.xlsx).

I'll sign the standard NDA via DocuSign once you send the link. Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Regards,
Angela
Sr. Procurement Manager, Midvale Health
Attachment: midvale-eval-questions.xlsx
